title: digest_schema
description: Digest projection of a JSON Schema file (schema/**/*.schema.json). Captures structural contract facts for cross-slice drift analysis without transferring the full schema source.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a schema digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root (e.g. schema/core/atoms.schema.json).

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time. Used as cache key component.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

schema_id.description: Value of the $id field in the schema (e.g. vc:core:atoms).

schema_uri.description: Value of the $schema field declaring the metaschema URI.

title.description: Value of the top-level title field if present.

required.description: Array of property names listed in the root required[] array.

optional.description: Root-level property names NOT in the required[] array.

additional_properties_at_root.description: True if the root object sets additionalProperties to a non-false value (or omits it). False means additionalProperties: false is set at root.

refs.description: All $ref URI strings found anywhere in the schema (recursive). Used to detect dangling references (D6).

enums.description: Map of property-path (dot-notation) to enum value list for every enum constraint found in the schema.

patterns.description: Map of property-path (dot-notation) to regex pattern string for every pattern constraint found in the schema.

has_definitions.description: True if the schema defines a $defs (or definitions) block with at least one entry.

def_names.description: Keys of the top-level $defs block (if present).
